title: Lightning damage
wikitext:
{{redirect|Lightning Damage|the passive skill|Lightning Damage (passive skill)}} '''Lightning damage''' is one of the five [[damage type]]s and is one of the three types that count as [[elemental damage]]. Landing a [[Critical Strikes|critical strike]] with a skill that deals lightning damage inflicts the [[shock]] [[status ailment]]. Lightning damage is mitigated by [[lightning resistance]] and reduction to lightning [[damage taken]]. Skills which deal or affect lightning damage have the "Lightning" [[gem tag]]. Some effects [[Damage conversion|convert]] other types of damage into lightning. ==Gems== A list of [[gem]]s with the [[gem tag]]: [[:Category:Lightning (gem tag)|Lightning]] ===Attack skill gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Lightning" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Attack" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ===Spell skill gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Lightning" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Spell" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ===Other skill gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Lightning" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Attack" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Spell" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ===Support gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Lightning" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ==Base items== The following base items are related to lightning damage: {{Drop enabled base item table |where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Lightning%Damage%" AND items.class_id NOT IN ("Active Skill Gem", "Support Skill Gem") |large=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Unique items== ===Flat added Lightning Damage=== [[Unique item]]s that add a flat amount of lightning damage or grant {{il|Added Lightning Damage Support}} to socketed skills. {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables = item_stats |join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName |where = item_stats.id LIKE "%added_lightning_damage%" |level=1 |stat_column1_header=Local Attack
Lightning Damage |stat_column1_format=%s-%s |stat_column1_stat_format=separate |stat_column1_stat1_id=local_minimum_added_lightning_damage |stat_column1_stat2_id=local_maximum_added_lightning_damage |stat_column2_header=Global Attack
Lightning Damage |stat_column2_format=%s-%s |stat_column2_stat_format=separate |stat_column2_stat1_id=attack_minimum_added_lightning_damage |stat_column2_stat2_id=attack_maximum_added_lightning_damage |stat_column3_header=Global Spell
Lightning Damage |stat_column3_format=%s-%s |stat_column3_stat_format=separate |stat_column3_stat1_id=spell_minimum_added_lightning_damage |stat_column3_stat2_id=spell_maximum_added_lightning_damage |stat_column4_header=Global Spell and
Attack Lightning Damage |stat_column4_format=%s-%s |stat_column4_stat_format=separate |stat_column4_stat1_id=spell_and_attack_minimum_added_lightning_damage |stat_column4_stat2_id=spell_and_attack_maximum_added_lightning_damage |stat_column5_header=Global
Lightning Damage |stat_column5_format=%s-%s |stat_column5_stat_format=separate |stat_column5_stat1_id=global_minimum_added_lightning_damage |stat_column5_stat2_id=global_maximum_added_lightning_damage |stat_column4_stat1_id=base_lightning_damage_%_to_convert_to_chaos }} ==Passive skills== There are [[passive skill]]s that grant lightning damage bonuses. ===Lightning damage=== These passive skills grant increased lightning damage. {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "lightning_damage_+%" }} ===Lightning damage with weapons=== These passive skills grant increased lightning damage with [[weapon]]s. {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "lightning_damage_with_attack_skills_+%" }} ===Lightning penetration=== {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%reduce_enemy_lightning_resistance%" }} ===Cluster Jewel passive skills=== The following [[Cluster Jewel]] passives are related to Lightning Damage: {{Passive skill table |q_where= passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%" AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%lightning%" AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%damage%" |large=1 |stat_text=1 }} ===Miscellany=== These passive skills are related to lightning damage, but do not fit into any other category. {{Query base passive skills |where= ( passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%lightning%damage%" OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%damage_%_to_add_as_lightning%" ) AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%resist%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("lightning_damage_+%", "lightning_damage_with_attack_skills_+%") }} ===Historic keystone passive skills=== The following [[Historic]] jewel [[keystone passive skill]]s are related to lightning damage: {{Passive skill table |q_where = ( passive_skills.id LIKE "%karui_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%templar_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%vaal_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%maraketh_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%eternal_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%kalguur_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%abyss%keystone%" ) AND passive_skills.name !="The Agnostic" AND passive_skills.name !="Glancing Blows" AND passive_skills.name !="Supreme Ego" AND passive_skills.name !="Wind Dancer" AND passive_skills.name !="Eternal Youth" AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%lightning%" |stat_text=1 |large=1 }} ===Keystone passive skills=== The following [[keystone passive skill]]s are related to lightning damage: {{Query keystone passive skills |where= passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Lightning%" }} to lightning damage: {{Query ascendancy passive skills |where= ( passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%lightning%damage%" OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%damage_%_to_add_as_lightning%" OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%convert_to_lightning%" OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%reduce_enemy_lightning_resistance%" ) AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%resist%" }} ===Tattoos=== {{Drop
